name: puppet-mcp
description: Windows desktop-control MCP server (npx launcher): provisions the pinned server binary from the GitHub Release on first run, then serves MCP over stdio

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('puppet-mcp: global install refused — use npx puppet-mcp@4.5.3');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('puppet-mcp: global install refused — use npx puppet-mcp@4.5.3');process.exit(1)}"
